A CONSISTENT ART DIRECTOR

Generative A.I. art is great. However, it does come with limitations. The illustrations it creates are inconsistent. The images are fine for a once-off use. But brands and businesses have longer-term needs and a cohesive style to think about.

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="60" screen_mobile_spacer_size="60"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-palette dfd_icon_set-icon-palette"]

A SKILLED ILLUSTRATOR & VISUALIZER

In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.

over 20 years. For better or for worse, generative AI is the impact that has hit professional illustration. I'm choosing to use it and ride where my illustration style takes the next few years of work. I have to say I am impressed — impressed with the impact it's having on parts of an illustrator's workflow: on ideation, world-building, and art direction, in particular. This age of generative AI will evolve artists quickly. And new illustration "gods" will come from the disruption.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]This technology has accelerated the scale of illustrations produced per year. — And it's all "hockey stick" growth from here on out... But notice this: how many illustrations on Midjourney have you seen in your favorite start-up's branding? How about for your supermarket's advertising? Brands and businesses need to think about how they can create new imagery styles — and leave behind the gaudy era of business stock photography once and for all. Questions & Answers

Generative AI Art

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="What is a generative AI artist?" tab_id="faqgenai-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

An artist who directs generative AI as a tool inside their own practice rather than treating whatever it produces as finished. At Oddtoe that is a hybrid workflow — AI image generation, graphic design and digital illustration used together.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What is a generative cartoonist?" tab_id="faqgenai-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A cartoonist who uses generative AI for character work and visual gags while keeping the writing, the timing and the final choice of image with the artist. The machine supplies options; the cartoonist decides which one is funny.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Why hire a professional AI artist instead of prompting it yourself?" tab_id="faqgenai-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Consistency. Generative AI produces inconsistent illustrations — fine for a one-off, a real problem for a brand that needs a cohesive style across a campaign or a series. A professional supplies the art direction that holds the look together across dozens of images.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What is Oddtoe’s background as an artist?" tab_id="faqgenai-4-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Illustration is the foundational skill, with a career that has taken in political cartooning, puppetry, data visualisation and street art. Oddtoe has worked since 2006 for organisations including National Geographic.

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • A SKILLED ILLUSTRATOR & VISUALIZER

    In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.  

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • AN INTEGRATOR

    The integration of generative A.I. art into content production is a massive challenge. How will one artist integrate generative AI into their workflows? How will the I.T. scale with different machine-learning algorithms? 

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

Looking for a

CREATIVE & GENERATIVE A.I. Resource?

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_column_text]

 As a generative A.I. artist, I wear many hats with what I do at Oddtoe: art director, head of illustration, lead character designer, visual editor, or background artist. Oddtoe is an experiential design and generative-AI animation studio based in Melbourne, creating projection, installation, and animated work for events, venues, and galleries.

[/vc_column_text]

Art generated by...

The Human Mind with Generative AI Riding in the Sidecar

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]I’ve been an illustrator for over 20 years. For better or for worse, generative AI is the impact that has hit professional illustration.
I’m choosing to use it and ride where my illustration style takes the next few years of work.

I have to say I am impressed — impressed with the impact it’s having on parts of an illustrator’s workflow: on ideation, world-building, and art direction, in particular.

This age of generative AI will evolve artists quickly. And new illustration “gods” will come from the disruption.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]This technology has accelerated the scale of illustrations produced per year. — And it’s all “hockey stick” growth from here on out…

But notice this: how many illustrations on Midjourney have you seen in your favorite start-up’s branding? How about for your supermarket’s advertising?

Brands and businesses need to think about how they can create new imagery styles — and leave behind the gaudy era of business stock photography once and for all.

Illustrations are friendlier, anyway.  🙂[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1787200000003{background-color: #322E34 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]
[vc_column_text css=”” item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Questions & Answers

Generative AI Art

[/vc_column_text]

[dfd_accordion style=”style-3″ active_section=”1″ font_size=”18″ tab_title_google_fonts=”yes” tab_title_custom_fonts=”font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal” icon_size=”14″][vc_tta_section title=”What is a generative AI artist?” tab_id=”faqgenai-1-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

An artist who directs generative AI as a tool inside their own practice rather than treating whatever it produces as finished. At Oddtoe that is a hybrid workflow — AI image generation, graphic design and digital illustration used together.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What is a generative cartoonist?” tab_id=”faqgenai-2-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

A cartoonist who uses generative AI for character work and visual gags while keeping the writing, the timing and the final choice of image with the artist. The machine supplies options; the cartoonist decides which one is funny.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Why hire a professional AI artist instead of prompting it yourself?” tab_id=”faqgenai-3-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Consistency. Generative AI produces inconsistent illustrations — fine for a one-off, a real problem for a brand that needs a cohesive style across a campaign or a series. A professional supplies the art direction that holds the look together across dozens of images.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What is Oddtoe’s background as an artist?” tab_id=”faqgenai-4-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Illustration is the foundational skill, with a career that has taken in political cartooning, puppetry, data visualisation and street art. Oddtoe has worked since 2006 for organisations including National Geographic.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/dfd_accordion][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
